verdict.rationale: Poly documents that new journal entries are stored as Markdown files in the Mind folder (poly-docs-12), and that Poly files appear as a real folder in Finder/Explorer (poly-docs-23), so notes sit in an open format you can reach through the normal filesystem. Two things weaken the archive-outlives-vendor goal: files download on demand, so a full local copy is not guaranteed, and the docs never describe a bulk export or how imported notes and memory are stored. missing for 10: documented bulk export, JSON or other structured export of Mind memory and metadata, confirmation that imported notes stay in Markdown, an offline/local-first guarantee, independent hands-on corroboration.
